OUR STORY

Three Generations. One Family. One Promise.

In 1958, Phillip M. Wedgworth started EnviroCare with one truck and one belief — that families deserved an Alabama pest control company that actually answers the phone and stands behind the work.

Sixty-eight years later, his grandsons Phillip, Kevin, and Lex Wedgworth run the company. Three Alabama offices. Same family. Same answer to your pest problem.
